versions.subject: New Rule - Linux Auditd Hidden Files - Steganography
versions.detection:
commands:
    type: EXECVE
    a0:
        - cat
a1:
    - a1|endswith: '.jpg'
    - a1|endswith: '.png'
a2:
    - a2|endswith: '.zip'
condition: commands and a1 and a2
commands:
    type: EXECVE
    a0:
        - unzip
a1:
    - a1|endswith: '.jpg'
    - a1|endswith: '.png'
condition: commands and a1
